title: Bridgeboard client blockers and actions - 2028-05-02
content:
Meeting: Solutions Engineering + ProServices weekly bridgeboard
Date: 2028-05-02 09:30 PT (30m) — Notes capture for action tracking and escalation
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya, Amir, Sofia, Ethan, Priya, Tyler (customer SE), Jenna (customer PM, joined for 15m)

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Three active customers with integration spikes this sprint: Bridgeboard (production cutover), Veridian (private deployment smoke), NimbusHealth (latency regression investigation).
- Highest priority: Bridgeboard cutover has a data-ingest failure on reserved capacity lanes (root cause: routing policy mismatch + kv-cache warmup). Risk: missed SLA for initial traffic (target 5/07).
- Actions assigned and owners listed below; need follow-up daily until resolved.

Per-customer notes:
1) Bridgeboard (priority: P0 -> cutover readiness)
- Current state: final validation environment green for tokenization and auth; discovery: intermittent 503s when routing to dedicated nodes at >130 concurrent sessions.
- Blocker: routing policy in customer config points to tiered pool name that was renamed in infra change; fallback to hosted model variant is not triggering because variant blacklist exists on customer account. Also KV-cache warmup not persisting across warm-up jobs -> cold-start latency spikes.
- Impact: estimated 12% request loss at target traffic shape; SLA risk window if not mitigated before 2028-05-07 cutover.
- Immediate actions: Amir to patch routing config script and push hotfix to customer control plane (ETA 2028-05-03 EOD). Priya to enable temporary auto-fallback policy for Bridgeboard account (ETA 2028-05-03 AM). Ethan to run KV-cache pre-warm job and provide warmup artifact for Bridgeboard (ETA 2028-05-03 noon).
- Contingency: If hotfix not in place by 5/06 morning, plan to throttle initial ramp to 30% and perform phased rollout with on-call SRE support.
- Notes: Tyler requested a short runbook for cutover steps; Maya to draft and send by 2028-05-03.

2) Veridian (priority: P1 -> private deployment smoke test)
- Current state: Private control plane deployed in customer VPC; smoke failures on KMS decrypt for embeddings route.
- Blocker: IAM role used by deployment misses kms:Decrypt for wrapped keys (policy oversight from partner infra template).
- Impact: embeddings endpoint fails auth check, causing regressions in downstream ranking pipelines.
- Actions: Sofia to coordinate with Veridian infra lead to update IAM template and re-run terraform (ETA 2028-05-04). Jonathan (infra partner) to confirm key ARN rotation schedule. Jenna (customer PM) to sign off after verification test.
- Risk note: rotation window next Friday 2028-05-09 could invalidate present keys; recommend postponing rotation until smoke passes.

3) NimbusHealth (priority: P1 -> latency regression)
- Current state: Observability shows 95th percentile token latency increased from 420ms -> 680ms after release of batching heuristics on 4/28.
- Investigation points: new batching heuristics increase window for small requests causing head-of-line wait; also a recent quantization profile change on dedicated nodes may be slowing decode path for their 2k context flows.
- Actions: Ethan to roll back batching heuristics in Canary for Nimbus cluster (ETA 2028-05-02 afternoon) and run side-by-side perf test. Amir to revert quant profile for one node-pool and measure delta. Sofia to update the perf-dashboard with comparison graphs (ETA 2028-05-04).
- Customer ask: Nimbus requested a 48-hour report and proposed mitigation; Maya to consolidate and deliver by 2028-05-04.

Cross-customer operational notes:
- Capacity/Autoscale: observed unusual burst shaping from one enterprise tenant that consumed 18% of spare capacity on 4/30; reminder to review autoscale thresholds for dedicated pools. Team to pick this up in infra sync on Thu.
- Rollouts & Fallbacks: confirm that account-level fallback policies are visible in Console UI for all pro-services customers; identified a UI gap where a renamed pool doesn't propagate to rollout policy pick lists. Product ticket created: JIRA-UX-6151.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Prioritize Bridgeboard routing hotfix over non-urgent perf experiments.
- Hold any key rotations for Veridian until afternoon smoke tests pass.
- Create a short standardized cutover runbook template for all future proservices cutovers (owner: Maya).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we need an automated test that validates routing policy names after infra renames? (Amir to propose test in infra board).
- Can we add an account-level “pre-warm cache” toggle in Console for customers with predictable bursty traffic? (Product follow-up: Sofia to scope with UX).
- Who will be the on-call SRE for the Bridgeboard cutover window 5/07 08:00–12:00 PT? (TBD — SRE rota owner to confirm by 5/04).

Action register (short):
- AMIR: patch routing config script + push hotfix (Bridgeboard) — due 2028-05-03 EOD — blocker P0
- PRIYA: enable temporary auto-fallback policy (Bridgeboard account) — due 2028-05-03 AM
- ETHAN: KV-cache pre-warm job + artifact upload (Bridgeboard) — due 2028-05-03 12:00
- SOFIA: coordinate IAM policy fix with Veridian + update perf dashboard (Veridian/Nimbus) — due 2028-05-04
- MAYA: cutover runbook draft + customer communication (Bridgeboard) — due 2028-05-03
- JENNA (customer): sign-off on Veridian IAM change once tests pass — pending

Notes to self / working ideas (informal):
- Consider adding a small smoke test suite (routing-policy, kms, kv-cache) that runs post-deploy for any customer infra change; could live in proservices CI.
- Draft a short Slack template for customer cutover updates (green/yellow/red) to standardize comms.

Next meeting: weekly bridgeboard sync — 2028-05-09 09:30 PT.

Raw attachments referenced: Confluence playbook link, JIRA tickets above, Slack thread for real-time logs.

End of notes.
